name: Enemies
overview: Scripture reveals that God is our defender and deliverer against our enemies, as He promises to fight for us and be an adversary to those who oppose us, encouraging believers to trust in His protection and courage. The Psalms express a heartfelt plea for God to contend with and deliver from those who seek harm, while also advising believers not to fret over evildoers. These verses underscore the assurance that God actively works on behalf of His people, providing both spiritual and practical deliverance in the face of opposition.
